test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains a spelling error.**

Most hobbies are to some extent __constructive__, but that they may be useful is of secondary __significance__, and that they may be __lucreative__ is a minor __consideration__.
solution:
The error lies in the word **"lucreative."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is **"lucrative" **and not **"lucreative."**
 
• **"Lucrative"** means producing a great deal of profit. (जिसमें अच्‍छा पैसा हो; लाभप्रद)
 
 
• **Example:** *She found a **lucrative**__ job in the marketing industry.*
 
 
 
• **"Constructive"** and **"significance"** are spelt correctly.
 
• **"Consideration"** is also spelt correctly and is used appropriately in the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence:** *Most hobbies are to some extent constructive, but that they may be useful is of secondary significance, and that they may be __**lucrative**__ is a minor consideration. *
